source_doc.title: NVIDIA PR: NVIDIA and Coherent Announce Strategic Partnership to Develop Optics Technology to Scale Next-Generation Data Center Architecture
source_doc.permission_basis: Corporate press release intended for public distribution; brief quotations stored in library/raw and this extraction.

sources.quote: NVIDIA is investing $2 billion in Coherent to support research and development, future capacity and operations as Coherent builds out its U.S.-based manufacturing capabilities.
includes an NVIDIA multibillion-dollar purchase commitment and future access and capacity rights for advanced laser and optical networking products.
With Coherent, NVIDIA is pioneering next-generation silicon photonics to enable AI infrastructure at unprecedented scale, speed and energy efficiency.

This strategic relationship underscores Coherent's role as a key enabler of next-generation AI data center infrastructure. We are proud to expand our 20-year relationship with NVIDIA by increasing their access to include multiple product families

claims.statement: Customer-side confirmation: NVIDIA is investing $2B in Coherent and signed a multibillion-dollar purchase commitment with future access and capacity rights for advanced laser and optical networking products, tied to Coherent's U.S.-based manufacturing buildout.
claims.disproof_condition: The agreement is terminated or materially reduced, or NVIDIA discloses shifting the committed volumes to another optics supplier.

claims.statement: Coherent CEO frames the deal as expanding a 20-year NVIDIA relationship to multiple product families, positioning Coherent as a key enabler of next-generation AI data center infrastructure (silicon photonics / optics).
claims.disproof_condition: Product-family scope is narrowed in later disclosures, or NVIDIA qualifies competing suppliers for the same families at comparable volume.
